notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
Welcome to Version 1.05!
This patch fixes some small bugs and has some minor gameplay improvements: With releasing the mobile game, I am happy to show the crossplatform capability of the game to play against the mobile version. So that means, you can pickup your mobile devices and jump into a desktop game of your friends ! Awesome !!

The patch includes some minor bugfixes like, the helping mouse disable button is working now and some other minor improvements.

Soon the games gets its leaderboards and achievements and as the game is running more or less smoothly the game will be released soon out of early access ! 

Patch Highlights:
- Mobile crossplatform multiplayer feature added (mobile version 4.55)
- Rank level adjustment
- Only rank 2 is needed to unlock multiplayer
- Improved Card design
- In game chat is back
 
Bugfixes:
- Helping mouse disable button
- Minor bugfixes
- Four of a kind bug in multiplayer (some players got a 4 of a kind with 3 cards)

Upcoming:
- Steam Leaderboards will be added
- Steam Achievements will be added

I hope you enjoy the game and have some fun together!

notes.title: 1.01 Update
notes.content:
Bugfixes:
- Friendslist saves now the friends you added in the previous game so you don't need to add them a second time on each startup
- Fixed the Private room join functionality
- Chat added
- Overall performance increase
